en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long, straight path flanked by balustrades and two large sculptural groups on pedestals in the foreground, leading toward an ornate Baroque palace-like building framed by trees. The printed caption at the bottom in red ink identifies the scene as the royal Great Garden in Dresden. Publisher information and date appear in small type along the lower edge.
